faq.question: Can you work around opening hours?
faq.answer: Yes. We schedule cleaning before opening, after closing or overnight, so that customers never see the work in progress.

faq.question: Do you know how to care for marble and other fine surfaces?
faq.answer: Our teams are trained to identify materials and use suitable products. For restoration work such as marble polishing, we work with specialist partners.

faq.question: Can you support an event at short notice?
faq.answer: Within our availability, yes. Contact us as early as possible and we will confirm the team and timing.
